notes: Seven distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The paired coat-closet and laundry-closet leaves were treated separately because they open and close in consecutive manipulations. Leaf identity and exact closing order are less certain than the other events because the doors overlap and sometimes leave the frame.
scene_description: A first-person traversal through an apartment entryway, coat closet, laundry closet, kitchen, and living area. The localized interactions are opening and closing two coat-closet leaves, two laundry-closet leaves, a refrigerator, an upper spice cabinet, and a utensil drawer.
